3. 완성된 짜이에 시나몬 파우더 톡톡 뿌려도 맛있답니다
4. 우유 대신 오트밀크로 만들어도 정~~~말 ~~ 맛있어 ~~!!!

6. 설탕 없이 해먹으니 하루에 두 세잔씩 마셔도 살도 안 찌고 너무 좋아요!

en.title: 🇬🇧 Autumn Break 2025: A Chimpanzee’s Ballet Expedition to London
en.description:
Well,
travel isn’t just about chasing famous restaurants, after all.

I really loved the moody, crisp colors of London’s parks.
The bread served with meals was delicious,
I met lots of animal friends,
and everyone I encountered was so, so nice.
Aside from the brutal cost of eating out, there isn’t a single bad memory to speak of…
It was a beautiful autumn break!

At Danceworks, the difficulty of the general class seems to vary slightly by instructor, but the class I took felt roughly equivalent to Level 3 at the studio in Korea, just for reference!

snippet.description:
겨울과 정말정말 잘 어울리는 음료 !
짜이를 모르던 때로 돌아가는 법 몰라요

🫚
촬영 이후로도 N번 이상 팔팔 끓여먹어본 결과

1. 어느순간부터 스파이스 계량은 의미없어지고.. 그냥 느낌대로 때려넣기 시작.. 진하면 진할수록 맛있기만 하구요^^ㅎ 제가 알려드린대로 가볍게 시작해보시고 취향껏 늘려가세요! 저는 시나몬이랑 생강을 팍팍 넣는 걸 좋아합니다. 계량보다 향신료 오바돼도 아무 문제없어요 그냥 편하게 편하게 유노 ~~!
2. 냄비 불 줄였다 올렸다 컨트롤하기 어려우시면 그냥 불은 그대로 냅두고 냄비를 들었다 내렸다하세요. 훨씬 컨트롤 쉬워짐
3. 완성된 짜이에 시나몬 파우더 톡톡 뿌려도 맛있답니다
4. 우유 대신 오트밀크로 만들어도 정~~~말 ~~ 맛있어 ~~!!!
5. 알룰로스 쓸거면 꼭.. 액상으로 쓰도록 하자.. 가루 알룰로스 쓰면 영원히 넣어야 함
6. 설탕 없이 해먹으니 하루에 두 세잔씩 마셔도 살도 안 찌고 너무 좋아요!
7. 제가 구매해서 쓰고있는 재료들 태그해두었습니다!



☕️ 1잔 분량 (230~250ml) 준비물 ☕️
시나몬스틱 3cm (좋아하시면 더 넣으세요!)
카다멈 3~4개
정향 1개
통후추 4알
생강 강판에 갈아서 10~12g (좋아하시면 더 넣으세요!)
혹은 생강가루 1/2 티스푼 (생강 대체) 
홍차잎 혹은 티백(아쌈 or 잉글리시블랙퍼스트) 4~5g
우유 혹은 오트밀크 150~200ml 취향껏!


냄비에 물 100ml와 향신료들을 전부 넣고 1분~ 1분 30초정도 강불에 팔팔 끓인다
우유를 붓고 다시 끓인다
우유가 따뜻해지면 찻잎을 넣고 다시 30초 보글보글
설탕 혹은 알룰로스를 취향껏 넣고 30초~ 1분 가량 보글보글
냄비가 넘치기 직전! 불을 끄고 체에 걸러 맛있게 먹는다
반드시 냄비를 바로 씻는다 (중요)
끝 !

en.title: Making This Delicious Chai is Faster Than Brewing Coffee! 🫚Homemade Sugar-Free Chai Tea Latte
en.description:
A drink that is perfect for winter!
I don't know how to go back to the days before I knew chai.


🫚
The result of boiling it and drink it over N times since filming

1. At some point, measuring spices became pointless.. I just started throwing them in based on my feelings.. The stronger the flavor, the better it tastes ^^ haha. Start lightly as I suggested, then adjust according to your preference! I love to add a lot of cinnamon and ginger. Even if you add too much spice than measured, it's totally fine, just relax and enjoy ~~!
2. If controlling the heat by raising and lowering the heat is difficult, just leave the heat as is and lift and lower the pot instead. It makes control much easier.
3. Sprinkling cinnamon powder over the finished chai is also delicious.
4. Making it with oat milk instead of regular milk is sooo~~~ good ~~ too~~!!!
5. If you're using allulose.. Make sure to use the liquid one.. If you use powdered allulose, you need to keep adding it forever.
6. Since I make it without sugar, I can drink two or three cups a day without gaining weight, and it's so great!
7. I've included tags for the ingredients I bought and use!



☕️ Ingredients for 1 cup (230–250ml) ☕️
A 3cm cinnamon stick (add more if you like!)
3~4 cardamom pods
1 clove
4 whole peppercorns
10~12g grated fresh ginger (add more if you like!)
Or 1/2 teaspoon ginger powder (as a substitute)
4~5g black tea leaves or tea bags (Assam or English Breakfast)
150~200ml milk or oat milk, depending on your preference!


Add 100ml of water and all the spices to a pot and bring to a boil over high heat for 1 to 1 minute 30 seconds
Pour in the milk and bring to a boil again
Once the milk is warm, add the tea leaves and simmer for another 30 seconds
Add sugar or allulose according to your preference and simmer for 30 seconds to 1 minute
Just before it boils over! Turn off the heat, strain through a sieve, and enjoy
Be sure to wash the pot immediately (important)
Done!

en.title: Low-Sugar Banana Bread Research Journal (Recipe)🍌🍞
en.description:
I swapped out half the flour with almond flour
and used 100% allulose instead of sugar.
Bananas are already naturally sweet,
but when I crave something sugary, I just have one slice with coffee as dessert
or grab a slice before working out as fuel.
If you eat it in huge bites, it will of course be too much,
but having a little every day as a slow sugar recharge doesn’t make me gain weight and feels great.
Especially before my period, this little guy really saves me… thank you so much.

If the inside isn’t fully baked, it kind of tastes like a damp towel,
★☆ so make sure to bake it long enough at a lower temperature~!!! ☆★
If you’re worried about messing it up, use a slightly wider pan or oven dish than the one I used
so the batter isn’t too deep and it will bake through much better~~!
For leftovers, cut them into single-serve pieces, wrap them tightly, and freeze.
You can put a piece straight on a plate and microwave it for 30 seconds without thawing~~!
🍌 Recipe credit goes to me and my GPT!

en.title: Who was this trip really for? 3 Nights 5 Days in Da Nang at the Hyatt Regency 🇻🇳
en.description:
It was my first time visiting Southeast Asia.
I had zero expectations, not because I didn’t expect much from Vietnam, but because I was focused solely on the fact that this was a trip for my mom.
Maybe that’s why I loved it so much… The food was so good. Really, truly amazing.
And everything was so cheap! I’d heard about it, but this was my first time actually feeling it.
Honestly… if Mom hadn’t been with me, I probably would’ve dedicated all 3 nights and 4 days to doing absolutely nothing.
So there’s a tiny bit of regret. Just a little, lol.
I already miss the chimpanzee rice I devoured every single day.

Beginner-level travel. No English needed (except at the hotel).
Everyone was so kind, so gentle… and as someone extremely sensitive to racial discrimination, Da Nang felt like a whole new world.
Thanks to that, I got to rest not just my body, but also my mind.
Also, ask for cilantro and they’ll give you some mystery greens (which are actually delicious).
You have to say “고수 주세요 (Gosu Juseyo)" in Korean to get actual cilantro in this hip city called Da Nang.

All in all, it was such a joyful experience!
